# Three.js r180 / 0.180.0

Vendored from https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180 under the MIT license
in `LICENSE`. These files are served locally; the visitor makes no CDN requests.

- `build/three.core.min.js`
- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- `examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`

The three addons' imports are changed to relative paths within this directory.
No other library code is modified. Preserve the license when redistributing.
